notes.title: Update 1.0.3.4
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/d512ed82cb25ab19645674dbc46bdc366ae6ecb4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Friendly ships no longer damage your team, you can now kick unwanted players from your online session, and a random name generator is now available during character creation. Plus, there are several other improvements and fixes.[/p][h1]Online Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where ships would get stuck during their destruction animation in online sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in online sessions that caused a player's ship to lose all its appliances and furniture when edited.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain quest items would be missing if the connecting player and the host were at different stages of a quest.[/p][/*][*][p]A kick button has been added to the current session panel for each connected player, allowing the host to remove unwanted players.[/p][/*][*][p]The location of each player is now displayed in online sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused some ships to damage their own allies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused a space station's barrier to disappear for a connecting player in a remote system.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where users who had left the server would not disappear from the interface for some connected players, causing the list to accumulate over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the map to function incorrectly if a player disconnected while using the system or galaxy map.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Other changes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the player's ship to teleport to the center of the star system when using the editor at a space station.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused teleportation to be too loud.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a series of errors that would occur if the player died while the map or ship editor was open.[/p][/*][*][p]Liberated pirate outposts now inherit the name of the pirate base and correctly display notifications when entering/exiting the zone.[/p][/*][*][p]A "Random name” button has been added to the character customization menu.[/p][/*][*][p]When splitting a stack of colored blocks, their customization is now preserved.[/p][/*][*][p]Knights who are part of story quests no longer change their appearance when transitioning to another planet.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Cubic Odyssey update makes the intergalactic Minecraft rival way more varied
notes.content:
Have you ever been playing Minecraft and wished you could take your adventure off terra firma and into the stars above? That's the premise of Cubic Odyssey, which launched on Steam in May 2025. Developer Atypical Games is still in the process of expanding what it has to offer, and the latest update overhauls the story-driven adventure mode to make every playthrough feel unique. While it was already easy to draw comparisons to the likes of No Man's Sky, this new change pushes things even further in that direction, in a good way.

Read the rest of the story...

New space sandbox game Cubic Odyssey is a Minecraft infused No Man's Sky rival

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.2
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/9f2072a098ac9de53004da4bfd22ac2ae7985806.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve improved random-seed generation, added several multiplayer tweaks, fixed a number of pesky bugs, and more. Plus, you can now sell off every ship in your fleet except for one that you choose to keep![/p][h1]Random seeding fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Generation of random seed planets has been further refined to make caves more elaborate and interesting.[/p][/*][*][p]An issue where points of interest of the same type could spawn on top of one another during the initial creation of random seed planets has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Online improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed a multiplayer issue where some appliances became permanently locked and could not be interacted with.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with item mods not updating correctly when transferred to another player in multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where the pilot could spawn outside of their ship when joining an online session.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Other fixes and changes[/h1][list][*][p]Players can now sell their ships, leaving only one final chosen ship. This function is available at any ship editor terminal.[/p][/*][*][p]Skin tone can now be customized for new characters. We plan to add an item that will allow appearance customization for existing saves as well in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]The planet map interface now shows the levels of available ore on that planet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue related to the “auto step” feature, which blocked movement through some 2-block high arches.[/p][/*][*][p]The target dummy has received an updated system for displaying damage dealt and damage per second (DPS).[/p][/*][*][p]Structures built from blueprints will now appear on the scanner, as they were previously impossible to find after being placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to the graphics API on Steam Deck and PS5.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the disappearance of the UI element that allows for rotating cubes during placement.[/p][/*][*][p]Trading resources from nearby chests now works correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fences and railings have been moved to a separate crafting tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused light sources to turn on every time the game was loaded.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused an incorrect outpost name to be displayed when entering or exiting a zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the player's rocket projectiles to collide with each other and explode in mid-air near the ship.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed instances where a sound would get stuck looping in one place during transitions between planets.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.1
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/37ab2a14f65cd5a15e4aa456ffbb0594ac73bb0a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ve prepared something special for you! Random galaxy seeds are here! Start a new game in Adventure mode and make the galaxy unique—every planet and star system is shifted to a new location, keeping things fresh even for the most experienced players. This update also brings numerous balance and gameplay tweaks, UI improvements, multiplayer polish and much more.[/p][h1][b]Adventure [/b]mode[/h1][list][*][p] You can start [b]Adventure [/b]mode games with [b]random Galaxy seeds,[/b] which change the galaxy completely.[/p][/*][*][p]Adventure mode will now start players with Tier 1 gear, a ship and a speeder on a random planet.[/p][/*][*][p]Only the same game-mode characters can join online sessions now.[/p][/*][*][p]Older adventure mode saves which don’t have a ship will be awarded the ship and speeder at the first load.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Online improvements [/h1][list][*][p]Online clients are now spawned flying their ships when joining a session in space.[/p][/*][*][p]Online clients will be spawned in their ship if they join a session on a planet.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the multiplayer ship sync logic – they will look smoother now.[/p][/*][*][p]Doors and elevators now properly sync over the network.[/p][/*][*][p]The server’s warp and portal locations are now completely synced with the clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Painting events with the paint gun are now synced across the network.[/p][/*][*][p]The Refinery and Recycler now work better over network, no longer duplicating items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing certain locked chests to appear unlocked to some clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing network grenades to explode twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Pirate base enemy count is now displayed for online clients too.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues causing the amount of darkness on a planet to be different between server and clients.[/p][/*][*][p]One can no longer place cubes on other player’s ships or the ones for sale.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Gameplay and balance changes[/h1][list][*][p]A setting to enable “one cube” stepping has been added. This setting can be restricted to “only while sprinting” too, so you won’t have to jump everytime.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleansed planet rewards now work properly, one player can receive the bonus each hour.[/p][/*][*][p]The outpost establishment and ranged have been refined to a smaller starting area but expanding by placing objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Neutral NPCs will react to high damage shots similar to more smaller shots and become defensive.[/p][/*][*][p]The players will no longer be allowed to repair speeders they already have in their collection and lose the resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Mimic creatures will show their true shape when getting hit – sometimes you killed one and never knew it was there.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Fixes & changes[/h1][list][*][p]The health hearts bar will now become a two line bar when you unlock more than 16 temples.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the missing speeders from the trader list when one had multiple speeders for sale.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ships going underwater in some situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing the UI to count small temples as big temples on the planet map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI overlap of a focused ship and creature at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where opening a second ship in the editor resulted in incomplete physics, preventing you from making changes.[/p][/*][*][p]The repair button has been removed from the Cargo section of the ship editor.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple UI overlap fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing some Speeder to be loaded under the textures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue blocking the hover mode in Creative mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues related to player ship deaths which caused ship to become invisible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the fire rate bonus indicator (it was showing as multiplied, but it’s just additive).[/p][/*][*][p]Planet portals will now place players in a nicer position and orientation.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous crash fixes and other minor performance and stability improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.14
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/f15357c60995f5d043bf3ba93e1e2fe333e61f38.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Your spaceship will no longer go into space without you, if your character dies during takeoff! We’ve improved online, fixed a number of bugs, and made block removal in the ship editor much easier.[/p][p]
[b]Online improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the two death overlap in some scenarios for online clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing items to get their durability reset when discarding them during online sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the initial portals list available from a server to its clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Travel portal discovery now propagates to everyone in the session.[/p][/*][*][p]Respawn positions for online clients will now favor their ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Using the ship editor as a client will change the current ship in the online session.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue duplicating the generation of planet content when a client saved a remote online session’s world.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the link between speeders and their traders not showing up always in online sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to the way a planet’s current corruption value got synchronized across network.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a situation when a planet state would not get saved if a client was disconnected from it and the host was in a different area.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the UI for the recycler for clients not always syncing properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the mining ray of the extractor positioning for clients on the server.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a set of issues related to client’s speeders: not getting removed when the client left, they are summoning back if another player used them.[/p][/*][*][p]Clients will auto-embark their speeders when summoning them in online sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing online clients not to receive XP for the piloting skill when destroying pirates in space.[/p][/*][*][p]The galaxy map will now display the host’s current warp gates discoveries, not the clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some rare occasions when a client would use a portal to another planet and end up spawned in lava.[/p][/*][*][p]The appearance of all quest related NPCs is no longer random for each player.[/p][/*][*][p]The host’s starting broken speeder can no longer be repaired and stolen by other players.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ships and speeders:[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[MAJOR] The Ship editor on the space station now allows for removal of “mass volumes” Just like the multitube placement the “left click” action hold will create a deletion volume which will remove all blocks in that section (assuming the player has space for them in their inventory).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with pirate ship sounds like they were player controlled and having an invalid volume.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue sending the ship into space and respawning the player on the planet if he died during the take-off sequence.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quests and achievements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue causing some NPCs and Quest items to show up doubled in the world.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some situations when a quest marker for a location on a planet will keep showing on different planets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unlocking of missed achievements/trophies by checking on game load and granting any that meet all the requirements.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A “hover mode” key has been added for the creative mode. It can also be triggered by double-jumping.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the missing gear stats update for some bonuses (like sprint speed) after a fresh load.[/p][/*][*][p]Appliances which will not result in a lootable disassembly have the disassembly effect red.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the trading menu not having the proper level requirement displayed when only one item was available.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the rotation action for some objects, which ended up with them inside the voxel supporting them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some AI positioning issues for some creature that have ranged attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing items duplication when leaving and rejoining a session in fast succession.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.13
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/21edbd97812fe641ef9348b84d3d9d150c1ed63a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Story NPCs no longer throw themselves recklessly into danger! We’ve fixed the “Jack of All Trades” achievement, made a number of graphical improvements, refined the UI, and also fixed several bugs related to online sessions.[/p][h1]Online improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue which did not allow clients to purchase or interact with ships for sale in certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Joining an online session in space will start with the player controlling his ship.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot shared in online session between players will no longer reset its durability.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lot of the ship’s incorrect behavior when syncing over network.[/p][/*][*][p]The current online session info will be displayed in the pause screen instead of the controls.[/p][/*][*][p]The online connection screen looks better now, it has a background.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Graphic and UI improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed a graphics issue with the player helmet being drawn during the game pause in first person.[/p][/*][*][p]Some UI overlaps have been addressed. Addressed a number of minor UI issues.[/p][/*][*][p]The save indicator is now displayed while the ship is being saved too.[/p][/*][*][p]Other ships in space are now valid cruise targets, both enemies and other players.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug fixes & other improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Certain main quest steps have been added safety checks. Quest NPCs are no longer allowed to be underground, for example (Casascutum really liked to go mining under the enemy base).[/p][/*][*][p]The “Jack of all trades” achievement has it’s on-load trigger fixed, should pop up for a lot of people when just opening the game if they ever had the 4 classes at least level 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to the fireflies visual effects.[/p][/*][*][p]The continuous fire after respawn was fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The paint gun will no longer paint the ship while it’s being internally processed, and those changes would end up lost. A warning is displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]The teleport inside ship and leaving the driving seat positions have been refined to fix moving into the ship’s walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lot of memory leaks, a handful of them were related to ship editing.[/p][/*][*][p]When teleporting trough planet portals, the player will no longer be placed on the highest block in the area.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some physics issues with the speeders, which did not allow connected players to interact with them in some situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a situation when the last change to a ship edit was lost.[/p][/*][*][p]More auto-saves are performed, especially for a server when another player disconnects while on a far away planet.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: An Update on Dedicated Servers!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/9ddb5c8211e8a436f79c14e0b4e80be9f86d4a0b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Back in May we shared with you the [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3400000/view/525343813853512621?l=english"]roadmap[/url][/u] for Cubic Odyssey, where we have planned to release an update with dedicated servers support at the end of July. We have come a long way since that day, working hard on the game, bringing a dozen updates and hotfixes, so you can enjoy your journey through the cubic galaxy both solo and with your friends.[/p][p]Yet, we’ve planned to launch dedicated servers in July, they will be released a little bit later, as soon as we’re sure they are working just fine for you to embark on a new journey with your friends. Since we’ve already started talking about dedicated servers, we wanted to share some more information that will quench your curiosity.[/p][p]Dedicated servers will be the best way to experience co-op play in Cubic Odyssey. They support more players than the current P2P servers and do not depend on the host, meaning you can play even when the host is away, as long as the server is live.[/p][p]You will need to create a new character that will be tied to the server. Your progression and inventory will be saved on the server, so you won’t lose any progress even if the server goes offline.[/p][p]A wide number of settings will be available for the owner of the server, where they can adjust game mode, password, etc. Once the server is created, its owner can share the session ID with the people they want to invite.[/p][p]Dedicated servers are absolutely free for everyone who owns the game and will be available via a separate application. For example, on Steam you will be able to find it in the Tools section of your library.[/p][p]In addition to that highly anticipated feature, we are working on “seeding” of the galaxy, which you will be able to try out on your newly created server as well, keeping the adventure fresh even for those who have already completed the story of Cubic Odyssey.[/p][p]We hope dedicated servers will bring you a lot of joy and memorable adventures with your friends and, in the end, will be worth the wait.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.12
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/9e0eab25648e21c3ff063f453fbd14678f79ede2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ve fixed a number of bugs and critical issues in online. Low-tier loot will no longer disappear, blueprints won’t request more materials than needed, and you don’t have to worry about deadlocks during online sessions anymore![/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the game to completely freeze during online sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue making low tier spawned loot disappear as it was spawned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing the blueprint yard to consume extra stacks of material when filling the needed blocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which saved and rewarded all server’s vehicles to the clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the spaceship sliding away from below the player when connected to an online session.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a controls issue with the speeders and vehicles when pausing the game with controls active.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the interaction indicator for online clients with pirate ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the missing HUD markers of pirate ships for online clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing the FOW and Markers of a planet to show up for another planet.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.10
notes.content: [p]Online sessions are now more stable, and many gameplay mechanics synchronize properly between the host and the client. We also have improved the speeders hovering system, fixed several bugs related to spaceships.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/ac8a85282a6d2059aa22bea8f6e89fe4db6af62c.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Online improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed looting of space chests as an online client.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a situation in which a client could not summon its speeder anymore after leaving it on some other planet.[/p][/*][*][p]Ship position and orientation sync over network has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]NPC appearance is now properly synced across network.[/p][/*][*][p]Derelict and for-sale ships now spawn correctly with their doors and driving seats for online clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Some quest steps will complete now for the host when a client performs them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which caused locked ship controls when joining an online session from a space station.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Spaceship and vehicle improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed more occasions which would reset a ship's design when repairing.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaks to the planet vehicles hovering system.[/p][/*][*][p]After unlocking the mobile planet purifier, the final step of purifying can be triggered from the player’s UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing multiple first broken speeders to spawn on the first planet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a situation in which a ship's damage FX would remain in the scene even after the ship would be removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues with the range from which a player could teleport back to his ship.[/p][/*][*][p]When replacing a ship’s battery, the HUD message now correctly reports the number of remaining batteries.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixes & other improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Some safeguards have been put in place now to not allow certain actions like repairing or modyfing a ship while it’s been processed by the game engine.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing the quest markers for the towers on Quberion to disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a situation which would have a temple spawn without its decorations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the stuck player’s firing of weapons during cutscenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a situation in which space darkness generators would respawn on load.[/p][/*][*][p]Planet portals UI will show only properly activated portals now (they used to show all discovered ones, even powered down ones).[/p][/*][*][p]The UI and Text scale options are not available on consoles too.[/p][/*][*][p]The reward chest from clearing a planet now spawns correctly at the base of the statue.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple crash fixes and other tweaks.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.7
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/5dd8cc36eef700c893f55bf762cfe84b1c1688c4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Pirates no longer carry grenade launchers or spawn near players! We’ve also made several balance changes and added some handy new features, including a chat wheel![/p][h1] New features[/h1][list][*][p]PC players can now use Shift and Ctrl(default mapping) for quickly transferring 1 item or the full stack of an object in the inventory UI.[/p][/*][*][p]A chat wheel has been added (Z key on PC and right shoulder while in the item selection wheel with a controller) to send a set of 10 predefined phrases to the online players.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Online Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Online clients auto save their current state like in offline.[/p][/*][*][p]The online weather system is now synced for planets, the host tended to overwrite all the galaxy with his weather.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the invulnerable pirates spawning only for a joined client.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed online gear colors not getting properly synced sometimes.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy turrets now synchronize properly even when the server is not around them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some situations in which a temple portal would not properly activate for online clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Locked chests are no longer used for pooled crafting by online clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Meteor crash sites now get marked on the HUD for online clients too.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the NPCs spawning in the floor of the space station for some clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a quick save button to the pause menu which works in Online Mode too to save the character, inventory and ship status.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Balance changes and gameplay improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Spawned pirates no longer have grenade launchers, Your structures are no longer threatened by large-scale destruction. Not just on PC, but across all platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]Re-balanced the weapon aiming sway for snipers and removed it completely for the other weapon types.[/p][/*][*][p]Elevators can now be mined back, and its behavior has been improved to stop at detected floors.[/p][/*][*][p]The radial quick wheel has received some usability improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]All players will no longer be automatically teleported after placing a portal on the ground.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug fixes [/h1][list][*][p]Fixed the missing health bars of enemies on some occasions .[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing pirates to spawn very close to the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect time zone for the save timestamp and wrong screenshots created during the quit to menu save.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.5
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/37f8485ecd160ec6f32587e2d41226fa3096cf28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ve improved online session stability, resolved some issues with controls on PC and consoles, and fixed a number of minor bugs.[/p][h1]Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Spawned pirates no longer have grenade launchers, Your structures are no longer threatened by large-scale destruction.[/p][/*][*][p]Online servers have their game mode marked with icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Crafted items will have mods of their tier if such mods exist for that object.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now destroy mods installed on items to free that slot for another mod.[/p][/*][*][p]Captured pirated bases become travel points for online clients as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Creative mode sessions are now allowed only for creative characters.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed the secondary quests the online clients could not turn in for completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some control locking issues happening when the quick slots selector was active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the quick wheel not always selecting properly when activated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some controller input issues when rotating or moving objects in an online session.[/p][/*][*][p]More small bug fixes and crash fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.3
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/dd6fa37dc8897567e68ed0ab659b075b7fa72d85.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Now the story progress will be smoother! In this update, we have fixed several bugs that caused some players to lose progress or get stuck on a storyline mission. Additionally, you can look forward to numerous improvements to the online mode and space travel![/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed the reward of freeing Helioctus not triggering always.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some situations where the darkness walker would not take damage in the static phase.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to transferring ship batteries from secondary cargo tabs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed items getting damaged more then they should have been when the player died.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some situations in which the main quest line would get locked with Nexus related tasks after returning from there.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash occurring when returning to a system with mined asteroids.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S save locks blocking the saving of the game altogether.[/p][/*][*][p]Added two game launch parameters for Steam: Vulkan and DX12 to force the game to start on that respective graphics API.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Online Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed the removal of the prison holding Helioctus not always happening for a connected client.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the inability of players to fix some broken ships in space when connected to a session.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing online clients to move and disassemble the appliances they placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue locking the quick-wheel radial menu from showing up if a client would get disconnected when it was active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some occasions when the client’s state would not get saved when getting disconnected from a notes.title: How to choose your spaceship
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/d84ce1a74a7d49f561b9f9bec990610849a5c256.jpg[/img]

You can find four different types of spaceships in Cubic Odyssey. They all serve their purpose and have their pros and cons. One ship will fit your style if you’re a huge fan of space battles, while another is great for carrying a huge amount of cargo. So let’s clarify what each type does — it’ll be easier for you to make a choice.

[h1]Scout — to infinity and beyond![/h1]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/262df0ba47091636b4fa30f71349af0ac1c7f231.jpg[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/85bce2ee6749ead6ef7354007753ef2d4da7df09.jpg[/img][/th]    [/tr]
[/table]
This is the first type of spaceship you’ll likely come across in Cubic Odyssey. The broken shuttle you need to fix on the first planet is, in fact, a Scout. It’s relatively fast, but not very durable, and its cargo space is quite limited. While its fire rate is higher than average, the damage is not that great — making it more suitable for destroying asteroids than for actual combat. Good options here include the Basilisk and the Infinity.
[h1]Fighter — conquer the galaxy[/h1]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/e251839900098a24d39440ac7024982e7c721836.jpg[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/8d746561167bfc7a46b8008e55f57282d9386db7.jpg[/img][/th]    [/tr]
[/table]
The Fighter is a great choice for those who want to conquer the galaxy, destroying all enemies along the way. It has a lot of HP and strong shields, making it almost indestructible. Its damage output is high enough to crush nearly any foe. Still, you’ll need to keep an eye on your ship’s condition and perform occasional repairs. Speed isn’t its strongest feature, though — so it’s easier to fight until the very end than to flee. If you want to try this type, look for the Planet Biter or the Argonaut.
[h1]Interceptor — fast and durable[/h1]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/c0745986cc4c6c552de58de548800e2fe88c9130.jpg[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/4c8ce9be497639b002161087891d20bcb7bbb515.jpg[/img][/th]    [/tr]
[/table]
This ship combines great durability with high speed. With it, you can cruise the galaxy without worrying about being destroyed, even by a large group of enemies. If you’re not in the mood for fighting, you can always flee — and even if they manage to catch up for a while, they probably won’t be able to break through your shields. Try the Infrared Furtive or the Ultraviolent Intruder if this is your kind of ship.
[h1]Titan — simply unsinkable[/h1]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/85408ddd40509422d244da5d38cbe3a344aad1c4.jpg[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/335abad752edff53f22b761ad186e26ef56d1c6a.jpg[/img][/th]    [/tr]
[/table]
The name kind of speaks for itself. This is the most durable ship type, able to absorb a huge amount of damage, and it also has the largest cargo hold. You can transfer all your valuable items without worrying about pirates ambushing you and taking everything. With their tiny ships, it would take a whole fleet of them to bring this beast down — especially since its weapons are as deadly as any other. Interested? Look for the Planet Bane, Camo Stellar Jet, or any other Titan-class ship.

What’s your choice? Do you already have a favorite spaceship to cruise the galaxy in Cubic Odyssey?

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.28
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/a5490ce32619a3cb47bd9097a064e070f5b4e356.jpg[/img]

Pirates no longer attack unmanned ships, the recycler no longer clones batteries, and several crash issues — including those when exiting the game, landing on planets, and some other cases — have been fixed. We’ve added cargo sorting for ship inventories and color customization for ramps, stairs, and railings.

[h1]Improvements and New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added item sorting to ship cargo tabs.
[*] Pirates no longer attack ships without a pilot, including doors and placed modules. Previously, even empty ships would get damaged, but now these targets are ignored by the AI.
[*] Ramps, stairs, and railings can now be painted in different colors.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Lowered VRAM usage on Steam Deck — this should fix crashes near pirate bases.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when landing on certain planets.
[*] Fixed an issue where exiting the game could trigger a false crash report.
[*] Fixed a bug where transferring one battery to a slot would erase the whole stack.
[*] Fixed a duplication bug with energy cells in the recycler.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the main quest to get blocked at the "Free the Queen" step
[/list]
[h1]Progress and Quests[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now abandon quests again in Adventure Mode.
[*] Fixed a progression blocker that asked players to re-purify Fintan 1.
[*] Fixed a bug that could block progression if pirate bases were cleared before the relevant quest was active. 
[/list]

notes.title: Speeders
notes.content:
Planets in Cubic Odyssey are massive, and sometimes traveling on foot can be slow and dangerous. That’s why the game features a variety of vehicles to help you move faster. Speeders are sold throughout the galaxy — just find a trader in the nearest city.
[h1]Arkana Ironclad & Arkana Invader[/h1]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/a545f060da0f7b6657b4ade02774277c278f8f82.jpg[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/eeebd00d6c03fc54807dbcb20d4e16a353229247.jpg[/img][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]
These are the most basic speeders you can find. They aren’t fast and only hover at low altitudes, but they’re affordable and will definitely help you early on. Don’t be too picky at the start of your journey!
[h1]Arkana Monster & Arkana Scrambler[/h1]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/5e80495717f87b23877060775d6ed8f74e5e747f.jpg[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/2e513f09cb4f3347d886e1623e8514e1dc8ca489.jpg[/img][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]
The Monster and Scrambler are slightly faster than their ‘Arkana brothers’, but still not the top-tier choices. If you’re looking to upgrade without spending too many qbits, these are solid options.
[h1]Arkana Intruder & Arkana Stellis[/h1]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/c28bb2bd650ea8ebb5678b900769df09896fcda8.jpg[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/ea33cb8d85659b6b37ae3cacec929197da73a813.jpg[/img][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]
The best of the Arkana series. These speeders are the fastest in their line, hover much higher, and equipped with powerful scanners — twice as effective as in earlier models. You’ll spot enemies and resources from much farther distances.
[h1]Racing Spark[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/40ce40b1c4e736e5a4a43940f1d82d750a3c3ea5.jpg[/img]
A bike-style speeder that outperforms others of its kind. Its unique design sets it apart, and it’s certainly will make your friends jealous. Fast, stylish, and effective — what else could you want?
[h1]Delore Dream [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/faef218f77d8fb25753d6ab904371e23a9d6b621.jpg[/img]
This one looks like it came straight out of a movie! It’s so fast, you might feel like it could break the speed of light, taking you back in time. And believe it or not, it’s still not the fastest vehicle in the game.
[h1]Turbo Star 9XX & Redheaded Stallion[/h1]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/962a478684beb8db399eddd50c439ca52cf9976e.jpg[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/52ea04c85c5a5e664607a46c4bc9b5430d9f8f23.jpg[/img][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]
These two are nearly identical in performance: top speed and best acceleration. The Redheaded Stallion comes with the most advanced scanner in the game and can hover up to 60 meters. They’re both absolute GOAT. Think of it this way: if they were basketball players, they’d be LeBron James and Michael Jordan. Which is which? You decide.

Which one do you like the most? Check all speeders out in Cubic Odyssey and add them to your collection.

notes.content:

Ship structures now save correctly after repairs, and hidden damage no longer blocks restoration. We’re continuing to refine control settings and address crash-related issues for a smoother gameplay experience.

[h1]Ships & Building[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where ship structure changes were not saved in the shipyard, for example after repairs.

notes.title: Hotfixes and Future Multiplayer Updates — 16.05.25
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/8f64168c20133f3e62c1d775cbf626da994cba2e.jpg[/img]

Post-release bug fixes and balance changes: damage to the player and his equipment has been reduced, pirates are not as bloodthirsty towards newcomers, anti-meteor turrets have become more effective. We also continue to work on Multiplayer fixes.
[list]
[*] Damage dealt to items in a player’s inventory upon death has been reduced by half.

notes.title: Weapons in Cubic Odyssey
notes.content:
In this episode, we'll be covering one of the most exciting aspects of Cubic Odyssey: weapons. What better way to go on a dangerous adventure than with an arsenal worthy of your hero? 

[h2]Melee Power [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/98df62d003eb47933272a6987225be19a4aed51b.jpg[/img]
If you prefer to act stealthily, suddenly, and up close, we've got a whole bunch of melee weapons in store. From the humble but effective shock baton, which can paralyze an enemy with a single touch, to light sabers of all colors and shades that can turn your enemy into smoking pixelated ash. Yes, getting up close and personal can be difficult, especially when energy projectiles are whistling overhead, but if you can pull it off, the result will be devastating. 

[h2]Shoot accurately, shoot powerfully[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/028e508685e62b8a2a8407b7f90ccb5d11555e29.jpg[/img]
Do you like to keep your distance? Then you'll love our ranged arsenal. At your disposal are pistols, automatic rifles, carbines, shotguns, machine guns and sniper rifles. Each barrel has its own characteristics: from accuracy and rate of fire to range and even the trajectory of energy projectiles. Don't forget about overheating - all our weapons use energy, and firing for too long can result in an annoying cool-down period during combat. 

But what makes our weapons truly unique are the modifiers, that not only improve the weaponry itself, but also change your play style. 

[h2]Explosive arguments [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/06e6e9c0e9a9a3943373ea0ebc4975caedba8561.jpg[/img]
When there are too many enemies and your ammo is running out, it's time to get out the grenades. In Cubic Odyssey, they are not only lethal, but also spectacular: they destroy the environment, create holes in shelters and frighten even the bravest opponents. Do you see a group of pirates hiding behind the wall? Throw a grenade — and the wall will disappear, as well as the pirates themselves. 

And if you want to throw exploding gifts from afar — arm yourself with a grenade launcher. Fast, effective, and most importantly — the enemy won’t even have time to work out what happened. By the way, if you have accumulated a lot of resources for creating grenades, you can use them to mine ore — isn’t that a treat? 

[h2]Light versus darkness [/h2]
Grenades for fighting the red darkness occupy a special place in the arsenal. These devices clear infected cubes over large areas, allowing players to safely move and restore the territory. Visually and in terms of gameplay, this is literally an act of purification! Our arsenal continues to expand, and we are not going to stop. We want every player in Cubic Odyssey to find a weapon that exactly matches their style, mood, and desire to create chaos. 

See you in the next diary — and don’t forget to load your favorite gun!

notes.title: QB-1 – Your Essential Companion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/c3f03d9f36e4d22f8d09218ae1c5d4f12df699c5.jpg[/img]
In Cubic Odyssey, QB-1 is your trusted companion from the very beginning. This drone provides you with essential starter gear: a basic extractor, a workbench, and a weapon—everything you need to survive. Additionally, QB-1 is always ready to guide you by providing information on your current objective, helping you navigate the world.

QB-1 is also invaluable for resource gathering. At your request, it can scan the terrain and highlight ore deposits, even if they are underground. However, don’t forget to use your character’s built-in scanner while mining underground—it will help you locate valuable resources nearby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/0d00278587c2727671a762bf79cd44529d05bf3d.jpg[/img]
You can upgrade QB-1 by installing three key modules:
[list]
[*] Stun Stick – Enhances QB-1’s damage, attack range, and critical hit chance. The drone can stun enemies, giving you a tactical advantage in combat.
[*] Drone Scanner – Increases the range for detecting ore deposits.
[*] PMU (Power Management Unit) – Manages the drone’s energy regeneration, extending its operational time.
[/list]
Upgrade QB-1 to make it an even more reliable and efficient ally on your adventure!

notes.title: Your Inventory: Energy, Freedom, Exploration
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/ab265c876d36272a4c277b1f2eed9662e6c01090.png[/img]

Welcome, explorers of Cubic Odyssey! In this issue, we’ll talk about your character and their inventory. The right equipment determines how far you can go in your adventures.

[h2]Battery – the heart of your gear[/h2]
Without energy, there is no movement, no exploration, and no defense. Batteries are a universal power source for all equipment: from the jetpack and mining laser to weapons. Even your ability to run in a spacesuit depends on them! If they run out, your equipment won’t shut down, but it will work much slower. However, over time, you’ll gain access to improved batteries with greater capacity—say goodbye to constantly searching for energy and carrying only what you need!

[h2]Jetpack – explore the world without limits[/h2]
Overcoming obstacles and reaching new heights are essential parts of Cubic Odyssey. The jetpack allows you to take off instantly, avoiding complex climbs and tedious tunnel construction while mining resources. Upgraded versions consume less energy and provide a longer flight time—letting you hover in the air longer and reach even greater heights to explore new horizons.

[h2]Scanner – your guide to the unknown[/h2]
Explore the world wisely! Your scanner helps you detect key points on the map: settlements, animals, enemies, and valuable resources. In space, it will lead you to asteroid belts, planets, stations, and warp gates. Your trusty drone has an even more precise scanner—it can locate the exact ore you need deep underground. No more searching for cobalt blindly—just ask QB-1, and it will show you the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/4325b0f60fca37b26e4a284d678f2b3a2e2af6a6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Backpack – space under control[/h2]
The more storage you have, the more resources you can carry. Upgraded backpack models allow you to store more items, while a handy filtering system prevents unnecessary clutter. Customize your collection settings—for example, exclude stone or dirt cubes, leaving them on the surface, and free up space for more useful items.

Get ready for thrilling adventures! In Cubic Odyssey, everything depends on you—what resources you take, what technologies you master, and how far you go in your journey into the unknown. Good luck, space pioneers!

notes.title: Create, Survive, Explore – Three Exciting Game Modes in Cubic Odyssey!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/6c18a465aaaf3d411564497da159f6e7ea0f10d3.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the world of Cubic Odyssey – a unique voxel universe filled with adventures, discoveries, and endless possibilities! You can choose how to play, since the full version of the game will feature three thrilling modes, each offering a unique experience.
[h2]Survival[/h2]
This is the classic game mode where you follow an engaging storyline, survive in uncharted worlds, and battle the terrifying Red Darkness. This mode was featured in the demo, and we’re confident that in the full version, Survival will bring even more content for you to explore.
[h2]Creative[/h2]
In this mode, you have access to all blocks, vehicles, and items with no limitations. There are no enemies or dangers, only endless freedom for creativity and self-expression. Build, experiment, and bring your wildest ideas to life without fear of losing your creations!
[h2]Adventure[/h2]
Every new journey begins on an unexplored planet! There are no story quests here – just you and an endless world full of mysteries. Decide for yourself how to progress, what to build, and where to go next. Your adventure is in your hands!

Which path will you choose? Dive into Cubic Odyssey and create your own story!

notes.title: Cubic Odyssey Demo Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439812/ce9e3c76a51e3f8b6d0140a19ffbe0588123f312.jpg[/img]
We’ve prepared a single-player demo for Cubic Odyssey.

[h3]The demo is available to download on the Cubic Odyssey Steam page[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456560/

The demo consists of one planet that players are free to explore while meeting the locals, fighting enemies, mining ore, building bases and fixing their spaceship. There are about 2-4 hours of exciting gameplay to introduce you to the game’s mechanics and quests. The demo is dedicated to the Miner class who has the perfect set of skills for your first foray into the Cubic Odyssey universe.
After you finish the demo, please leave your feedback — this is very important to us. You can find the link to the survey in the main menu. Since we plan to make changes to the game according to your feedback, we won’t transfer your demo progress to the release version. So feel free to try out everything, experiment, and freely enjoy the game and then tell us what you think!
